doc: Field objects' own sounds when used (M3-AUD-864; interact_sfx.json maps the objects; InteractAudio plays them at the object). Files from assets_src/sfx/act1_foley_detail_sfx.py (plain git, ADR 0174). Same row format as sfx.json; AudioData.sfx_rows merges this file in.

obj_rope_cut._note: M3-AUD-864: a lashing cut: the knife's strokes through wet rope, the rope parting, the slack falling

obj_tether_drop._note: M3-AUD-864: a tether let run: rope paying out fast through the hands, the drop's thump at the bottom

obj_hinge_pry._note: M3-AUD-864: a brass hinge prised free: a metal groan, the pin popping, the brass in the hand

obj_tin_open._note: M3-AUD-864: an old tin: the rusted lid levered off, its contents rattling

obj_take_small._note: M3-AUD-864: a small thing taken up (a charm): a light knock and a cloth fold

obj_door_locked._note: M3-AUD-864: a shut door tried: the latch rattled, the wood holding
